Name: Softer Hair for Soft Farmer
Author: Licalia
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]

[size=3]I love the new Sprites by Crisaius, but unfotunately any mod for lighter hair is not compatible with Soft Farmer.
I have no exprience with modding, but managed to[/size] edit the hairstyles for a more fair-haired character and simply thought I'd release my files here in case someone might find them useful.

[list]
[*]All credit for the assets goes to Crisaius. This is a very simple edit.
[*]Can be disabled in [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or the config file so it can be useful for different characters.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Credits[/size]

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37809]Lighter Hair Color[/url] for Vanilla Farmer Sprites.
